1. Configuración inicial

library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
base <- read_excel("FINAL EVELYN.xlsx")

2. Variable Edad
Escritura
Copiar
base <- base %>%
mutate(
edad_grupo = case_when(
edad == 1 ~ "60 a 70 años",
edad == 2 ~ "71 a 80 años",
edad == 3 ~ "81 a 90 años",
TRUE ~ NA_character_
)
)

base %>%
count(edad_grupo) %>%
mutate(porcentaje = n/sum(n)*100)

Copiar

base %>%

4. Percepción Total
Escritura
Copiar
base <- base %>%
mutate(p_total = rowSums(across(p1), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
mutate(
p_total_cat = case_when(
p_total <= 3 ~ "Desfavorable",
p_total <= 5 ~ "Medianamente favorable",
p_total <= 8 ~ "Favorable"
)
)

base %>% count(p_total_cat) %>% mutate(porcentaje = n/sum(n)*100)

p_sens %in% 3:4 ~ "Favorable"
)

7. Medidas de Tendencia Central
Escritura
Copiar
resumen <- base %>%
select(p_total, p_sens, p_imp_int, ac_total, ac_cog, ac_afect, ac_cond) %>%
summarise(across(everything(), list(
N = ~sum(!is.na(.)),
Media = ~mean(., na.rm = TRUE),
DE = ~sd(., na.rm = TRUE),
Mediana = ~median(., na.rm = TRUE),
IQR = ~IQR(., na.rm = TRUE),
Min = ~min(., na.rm = TRUE),
Max = ~max(., na.rm = TRUE)
), .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"))
resumen

9. Correlaciones de Spearman
Escritura
Copiar
library(purrr)
library(broom)

vars <- c("p_total", "p_sens", "p_imp_int", "ac_cog", "ac_afect", "ac_cond")

cor_tabla <- map_dfr(vars, ~{
cor.test(base[[.x]], base$ac_total, method = "spearman") %>%
tidy() %>%
mutate(var_indep = .x, var_depend = "ac_total")
}) %>%
mutate(estimate = round(estimate,3),
p.value = round(p.value,3),
interpretacion = if_else(p.value < 0.05, "Significativa", "No significativa"))

cor_tabla

10. Modelos RP Bivariados
Escritura
Copiar
library(broom)

vars <- c("edad_grupo","sexo","p_total_cat","p_sens_cat","p_imp_int_cat","ac_cog_cat","ac_afect_cat","ac_cond_cat")

ajustar_modelo <- function(var) {
formula <- as.formula(paste("ac_total_dic_num ~", var))
modelo <- glm(formula, family = quasipoisson(link = "log"), data = base)
tidy(modelo, exponentiate = TRUE, conf.int = TRUE, conf.level = 0.95) %>%
mutate(variable = var)
}

resultados <- lapply(vars, ajustar_modelo) %>% bind_rows() %>%
select(variable, term, estimate, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) %>%
rename(RP = estimate, IC_inf = conf.low, IC_sup = conf.high, pvalor = p.value) %>%
filter(term != "(Intercept)")

resultados
write_xlsx(resultados, "Rp_bivariados.xlsx")
